findings.problem: The shell guard takes auto mode from the command's cwd tree but classifies the target by a rel stripped of a leading .claude/worktrees/<x>/: a shell write into a sibling worktree gets the cwd tree's auto rules (ledgered, no ask) and the ledger row names $GUARD_AUTO_TREE/$rel, a file that did not change; protect-files, the freeze and loop_auto take the tree from the file.

A verdict-backed .tdd-unfrozen line committed by an auto pass reads as a whole-file exemption once auto mode no longer holds (after the merge); nothing refuses a PR whose .tdd-unfrozen still carries active lines (the block lists the file).
gate_answer falls back to tool_input.answers; only pre_ask on PreToolUse stops a pre-filled gate and that hook has no onFailure: block.

The verdict ledger trusts agent_type arbiter; .claude/agents/ is not guarded, so an agent definition named arbiter can be written or edited with no ask (kit repo: arbiter.md is neither guarded nor kit code).
